sampled.finding: The record preserves a learning process rather than a polished argument: the group moves from broad ideological framing and preliminary knowledge of 南機場 to fieldwork, recognizes that the urban-renewal problem is too complex to solve wholesale, and narrows its intervention toward actors who can influence actual planning and implementation. terminus.candidate: Student/course materials can preserve decision-process traces—how a broad problem is narrowed into an actionable target—even when their final conceptual claims are ordinary.
